facility.name: Totally Kids Learning Center
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Skill Classes,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 2211 E GRIFFIN PKWY, MISSION, TX, 78572

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Diaper changing mat in the infant room is torn and a cabinet in the toddler 2 room is broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: One of ten staff files reviewed is missing a foreign diploma translation / equivalency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Last fire drill was conducted on 08/05/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Last fire inspection was conducted on 08/27/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: One out of eight staff training records reviewed is missing up to date first aid and pediatric CPR training certificate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids: A caregiver did not wash their hands after handling vomit in a pre-k room.         Note: This was addressed with the caregiver and the caregiver washed their hands during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids: A caregiver did not wear gloves when cleaning up vomit from the floor in a pre-k room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Must Wear Gloves When Handling Blood or Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3425(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Three caregivers did not have their training record available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two caregivers were observed caring for seven infants and a school-aged child in the infant room. There was more than an 18 month difference in age between the youngest child and oldest child in the group. The youngest child was 3 months of age and the oldest child was 6 years of age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: The operation policies reviewed were missing the criteria the center will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Two caregiver's were missing clock hours of pre-service training.     A caregiver with a DOE 08/01/2023 was missing 7 of 24 clock hours of  pre-service training.    A second caregiver with a DOE 8/28/2023 was missing 16 of 24 clock hours of pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Seven infant bottles were not labeled with the child's name and initial of last name in the infant room.      Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the bottles were labeled with the required information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: Pretzels were served as part of the lunch meal to toddler children. This posed a safety hazard as pretzels present a risk of choking.        Note: This was addressed with the staff and all pretzels were removed from the toddler children's plates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §746.3317(7))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Children's Products Certification form that is used to certify that the center has reviewed each of the recall notices issued by the CPSC was not current.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the CPSC website was reviewed and the form was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: The director's credential was not maintained and no longer current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: A caregiver's pediatric CPR training completed did not adhere to the guidelines for CPR for a layperson established by the American Heart Association. Re-cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver caring for a group of children was still missing training in Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. Re-cited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 6 children's immuniation records reivewed was not current.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans: A list of a child's food allergies was not posted in the kitchen and in each room where the child spends time.               Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a list was created and posted in the required rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: There was no documentation available to verify that the center conducts monthly tests on smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detector or monthly checks on fire extinguishers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The center did not have a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver caring for a group of children was missing training in Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: A caregiver's pediatric CPR training was completed onlline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: A container of disinfecting wipes, a can of lysol disinfectant spray, and a bottle of hand sanitizer were observed on top of a rolling cart in a toddler room. This posed a safety hazard to children as the cleaning supplies were within children's reach.       Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the cleaning supplies were stored out of children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver's pediatric first Aid training was expired. The certficate of training had an expiration date of 06/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: A caregiver completed standard CPR training online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: There was no Food Allergy Emergency Plan available for review for a child with a diagnosed food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: A caregiver's education documentation received outside of the United States was not translated into English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 2 of 6 children's records reviewed were missing the child's emergency contact's address. 1 of 6 children's records reviewed did not have an emergency contact listed.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the required information was documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: A caregiver was missing annual training for training year 10/06/2020- 10/05/2021 on the following topics:     (1)Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;  (2)Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and  (3)Understanding early childhood brain development.    -Prevention, recognition, and reporting of child maltreatment; and     (1)  Emergency preparedness;    (2)  Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations;    (3)  Administering medication, if applicable, including compliance with 746.3803 of this chapter (relating to What authorization must I obtain before administering a medication to a child in my care?);    (4)  Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;    (5)  Understanding building and physical premises safety, including identification and protection from hazards that can cause bodily injury such as electrical hazards, bodies of water, and vehicular traffic; and    (6)  Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with 746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
